purpose: To represent a document belonging to a site in the data layer.
content_gaps: No workflow or usage instructions are described.

summary: Implements a staff admin welcome page with site and discipline filtering, date pickers, error/warning handling, and a display grid for employment applications.
purpose: Allow admin staff to view and filter employment applications by site, discipline, and date, with supporting UI components for validation and feedback.

fields.name: txtStartDate
fields.description: Input for filtering applications by start date.

fields.name: txtEndDate
fields.description: Input for filtering applications by end date.

workflows.name: Filter and View Employment Applications
steps: Page loads with user session and UI initialized.
Admin clicks refresh or changes dropdowns.
Grid is updated with employment application data matching filters.
Admin can view details, email, and status.

business_rules: Only applications within selected date range are shown.
Withdrawn applications are only shown if enabled.
validations: Start and end dates are required (RequiredFieldValidator).
Date fields must match the expected format (RegularExpressionValidator).
End date must not precede start date (CustomValidator with checkStartEnd).
conditions: If no user session, selection is cancelled.
If site/discipline not selected, show all (uses 'ALL' marker).
system_behavior: On load: initialize fields, set up dropdowns and grids.
On dropdown/data change: refresh data grid.
content_gaps: No details on security, exceptions, or custom actions available.

summary: Defines and manages service codes and their localization. Provides methods to list, localize, and retrieve service codes by Course or Timetable.
purpose: To list and manage service codes for categorization and reference, supporting multiple languages.

workflows.name: List Service Codes for Course or Timetable
steps: Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID or ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID with session and ID.
Fields are localized if alternate language is active.

business_rules: When UseAltLanguageFields is true, Name is set to NameAlt.
conditions: Localization depends on session language mode.
system_behavior: Retrieves and localizes service code lists.
Supports fetching by either CourseID or TimetableID.
content_gaps: No UI or end-user logic is described.

summary: Tracks and displays historical actions taken on a site's profile, with reference to users, agencies, screen sections, and formatted display of user details.
purpose: To provide an audit trail and summary of changes for a site's profile in the system.

workflows.name: Site Profile Change Tracking
steps: On action, system logs details (section, action, fields, user, agency, date).

business_rules: If ByUserSysAdmin is true or user IDs match, no support team notation is added to display.
Uses alternate language fields if session is set for alt language.
calculations: AgencyUserFormatted: Constructs user display string with initials and agency.
TooltipDetails: Constructs details with name, agency, and phone.
system_behavior: Populates UI with user and action information for display.
ObjectDataSource parameters checked for valid session and site.
content_gaps: No UI layout or front-end event handling included.

summary: Defines documents presented in an email popup context, supporting creation, listing, and deletion of email-related files.
purpose: To manage email attachments or documents in a popup interface, allowing for selection and file deletion.

workflows.name: List and Delete Popup Documents
steps: Call Search with DataInfo string to produce file list.
Call Delete with DataInfo and ID to remove a file and its folder if empty.
Handles file and directory deletion with error suppression.

business_rules: Each document is parsed from a delimited DataInfo string.
File deletion is attempted and errors are ignored.
conditions: If DataInfo string is empty, no documents are returned.
If emailData does not split into two parts, entry is ignored.
system_behavior: Parses document info from a string.
Deletes file and folder using filesystem operations.
exceptions: File deletion and folder deletion exceptions are caught and ignored.
content_gaps: No UI or triggering workflow beyond internal methods.
